description:
WHY JOIN THE TEAM?

You will have to look long and hard to find a digital development gig like this in Montreal. A canadian multinational company that is growing at an unprecedented rate and that is actively throwing it’s full weight into its digital transformation. BRP remains true to its roots

We are looking for a highly skilled developer who is comfortable with mobile (Android and iOS) and the back-end programming needed to deliver a complete application. You will be working on developing and designing applications used by owners of our Vehicles.

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

As a full-stack application Developer, reporting directly to the Digital Lead Architect, you will be part of the connectivity innovation team constantly improving BRPs Consumer applications and be directly involved in BRPs digital products initiatives.

The BRP Digital team has two offices in the province of Quebec, one is in Montreal the other in Sherbrooke. Our spaces are fully designed to stimulate innovation, co-creation, collaboration with the various teams (CRM, Digital and product engineering) and to have fun at work!

You will

  • Participate in the development and maintenance of the mobile application and its back-end; including any interface with other systems (e.g. iOS&Android applications, Vehicle Hardware API)
  • Collaborate with Product owners and UX team to constantly improve the experience
  • Write automated test to ensure code and application quality
  • Participate in all areas of product life cycle, including discovery, planning, development, delivery and production support.

YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Excellent knowledge of either Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift) development and native-hybrid frameworks (Kotlin-multiplatform)
  • Experience with Bluetooth and WiFi protocols
  • Familiarity with database technology such as MySQL, MariaDB and MongoDB.
  • Excellent knowledge of API protocols (Rest & GraphQL)
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud services
  • Excellent communication skills (in either French or English).
  • Experience in a corporation setting a plus
  • Experience working with a development provider a plus
  • Proven track record of prioritization of own work
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Attention to detail

ACKNOWLEDGING THE POWER OF DIVERSITY

BRP is dedicated to nurturing a culture that invites, connects, and propels the ambitions of people of all backgrounds, profiles, beliefs, and experiences. Ultimately, the diversity and uniqueness of our people fuel our ingenuity and set the course for the path ahead!

For this reason, we value diversity and we strive to always push each other forward to build an inclusive workplace where every employee feels like they belong, where they can grow and find meaning.

WELCOME TO BRP

We’re a world leader in recreational vehicles and boats, creating innovative ways to move on snow, water, asphalt, dirt, and even in the air. Headquartered in the Canadian town of Valcourt, Quebec, our company is rooted in a spirit of ingenuity and intense customer focus. Today, we operate manufacturing facilities in Canada, the United States, Mexico, Finland, Australia, and Austria, with a workforce made up of close to 16,000 spirited people, all driven by the deeply held belief that at work, as with life itself, it’s not about the destination; It’s about the journey.

Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um Analista Funcional para atuar em projetos de mapeamento de processos e apoio à transformação digital, com foco em soluções voltadas para canais de atendimento. O profissional será responsável por entender as necessidades das áreas de negócio, modelar processos e apoiar a implementação de soluções tecnológicas.

  • Produzir documentos funcionais, fluxogramas e apresentações executivas para apoiar a tomada de decisão e o desenvolvimento da solução;
  • Atuar como ponte entre as áreas de negócio e a equipe técnica, garantindo o entendimento e a rastreabilidade dos requisitos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada como Analista Funcional em projetos de mapeamento de processos e transformação digital;
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos (ex: BPMN) e ferramentas como Visio, Bizagi, Lucidchart ou similares;
  • Vivência com sistemas de atendimento multicanal (telefone, chat, e-mail, CRM);
  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação, organização e relacionamento com áreas diversas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com projetos envolvendo Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);
  • Certificações em análise de negócios (CBAP, PMI-PBA) são um diferencial.
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição (Swile): R$ 660,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Home Office: R$ 100,00/mês;
  • Auxílio Creche (conforme acordo coletivo);
  • Plano de Saúde SulAmérica Clássico (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Plano Odontológico SulAmérica (100% custeado pela empresa, sem coparticipação);
  • Auxílio Educação Alura (mensalidade paga 100% pela empresa);
  • Parceria com escolas de inglês e faculdades;
  • Total Pass: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Wellhub: academias e aplicativos educacionais com descontos;
  • Acesso ao Sesc São Paulo.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a BetterNow, uma consultoria em qualidade de software que valoriza relações próximas, processos simples e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Nosso propósito é criar soluções que realmente façam a diferença, com foco na excelência, na transparência e na entrega de valor para os nossos clientes. Aqui, você vai encontrar uma cultura aberta, que valoriza a troca de ideias, o aprendizado contínuo e a autonomia. Trabalhamos com metodologias ágeis, buscamos inovação e acreditamos que, mais do que processos, são as pessoas que garantem a qualidade em cada entrega. Se você busca um ambiente dinâmico, com desafios reais e oportunidade de crescer junto, a BetterNow é o seu lugar!

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Role and Responsibilities

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers daily in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment-related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user IDs, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as a liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate the completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP-based interfaces using IBM and third-party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem-free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software-based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX HA1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface/job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS.
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser-based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks on time to ensure PCI compliance
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially related to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities on time
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Experience

  • Extrair, limpar e tratar dados de vendas históricas no ERP/APS.
  • Rodar modelos estatísticos e gerar relatórios de baseline por SKU, categoria, canal e mercado.
  • Atualizar dashboards semanais/mensais de previsão (Power BI, etc.).
  • Conduzir workshops de alinhamento de demanda com áreas envolvidas.
  • Consolidar informações e preparar materiais para o Demand Review Meeting.
  • Manter registro formal de premissas, riscos e decisões tomadas.
  • Suportar auditorias e revisões de governança sobre o processo de S&OP.

Requirements and qualifications

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência na área de Supply Chain, Planejamento de Demanda ou Planejamento de Suprimentos.
  • Domínio em modelagem estatística de Forecast e ferramentas de previsão de demanda.
  • Conhecimento e prática nas auditorias do mercado farmacêutico: IQVIA e Close UP.
  • Noções de finanças e custos operacionais e gestão de estoque.
  • Conhecimentos avançados em Microsoft Excel (Pacote Office) e sistemas ERP como SAP.
  • Estabelecer e manter o princípio de One Number / One Source of Truth, evitando desalinhamentos ou múltiplas versões de dados.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau), Alteryx.

Nice to have

  • Vivência em indústria farmacêutica, Cosmética e Alimentícia;
  • Vivência em processos de S&OP, S&OE ou áreas de planejamento integrado.
  • Pós‑graduação ou MBA em Supply Chain, Planejamento ou Gestão Empresarial
  • Conhecimento no Sistema SAP S/4HANA

Additional information

  • Local de trabalho (Base): Teletrabalho (disponibilidade para encontros presenciais pontuais durante o ano).

Arquitetura e Design Da Solução

Conhecimento Técnico

  • Profundo conhecimento da linguagem C# e do ecossistema .NET.
  • Sólido conhecimento de padrões de design de software (Design Patterns).
  • Conhecimento de princípios de arquitetura de software (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de práticas de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de testes (TDD, BDD).
  • Familiaridade com Docker e Docker Compose.
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD (Integração Contínua / Entrega Contínua).
  • Conhecimento de IaC (Infraestrutura como Código).

Habilidades

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e colaboração para trabalhar em equipe.
  • Habilidade de análise crítica e resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.
  • Habilidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Training Review Layer (Python)
description:
Overview

You’ll join an expert annotation team to create training data for the world's most advanced AI models. No previous AI experience is necessary. You'll get your foot in the door with one of the most prominent players in the AI/LLM space today. We seek software engineers with 4+ years of experience to train large AI language models, helping cutting-edge generative AI models write better code. Projects typically include discrete, highly variable problems that involve engaging with these models as they learn to code. We currently have 200+ roles open!

What Will I Be Doing?

  • Evaluating the quality of AI-generated code, including human-readable summaries of your rationale
  • Solve coding problems, writing functional and efficient code
  • Writing robust test cases to confirm code works efficiently and effectively
  • Solving coding challenges, creating instructions to help others, reviewing the code before it goes into the model, and handling a variety of projects (e.g., determining which piece of Python code is better, or building a full mobile application using a chatbot and improving its responses)

Pay Rates

  • Pay rates vary based on location and seniority; see the provided list.
  • Expectations are 15+ hours per week; there is no upper limit. Some engineers work 20-40 hours per week, and others 40+ hours per week. You are paid weekly per hour of work on the platform.
  • Long term, there is no end date; they expect work for the next 2 years.
  • You can end the contract at any time. While 12 months of work is ideal, if it isn’t a fit you can disengage.

Flexible Schedules

  • Developers can set their own hours. It’s ideal to be available for around 40 hours per week and to adapt to project urgency, with strong flexibility on working hours.
  • A 3-hour lunch break is acceptable. Instead of tracking hours, you are paid according to time spent on the platform, calculated in the coding exercises.

Interview Process

  • Apply using the Ashby form.
  • If you seem like a good fit, you’ll complete an async RLHF code review that requires about 35 minutes and must be finished within 72 hours.
  • You’ll receive credentials to the RLHF platform. A group call will be set up to answer onboarding questions with the company.
  • Perform a simulated production-level RLHF task on the platform. This final interview will determine employment and leveling; successful completion provides an opportunity to work on projects as they become available.
  • The current priority for this team is software engineers who are well-versed in Python.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, OR Bachelor’s in Computer Science / Engineering / STEM with 4+ years of specialized experience
  • Complete fluency in the English language
  • Ability to articulate complex scientific concepts clearly and engagingly
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to maintain consistency in writing
  • Solid understanding of grammar, punctuation, and style guidelines
  • Proficiency with Python

Nice To Haves

  • Recognized accomplishments or contributions to the coding community or in projects
  • Proven analytical skills with an ability to approach problems creatively
  • Adept communication skills, especially when understanding and discussing project requirements
  • A commitment to continuous learning and staying updated with the latest coding advancements and best practices
  • Enthusiasm for teaching AI models and experience with technical writing

title: Especialista em Infraestrutura e Automação
description:
Especialista em Infraestrutura e Automação

Estamos em busca de pessoas fascinadas por criar um futuro melhor, que sejam inquietas, tenham coragem para desafiar o comum, que valorizem a diversidade de ideias e acreditem no potencial transformador da colaboração verdadeira.

Sabemos que muitas pessoas — especialmente mulheres — só se candidatam a uma vaga quando acreditam que cumprem 100% dos requisitos. Se esse for o seu caso, a gente quer te encorajar a se inscrever mesmo assim. Pra nós, o que importa de verdade são as trajetórias diversas e os aprendizados que você colecionou ao longo do caminho.

Junte-se a nós na busca por um mundo com novas intelligências.

Este papel apoia a operação segura e eficiente da Kunumi, garantindo a gestão de acessos, sistemas e ambientes técnicos internos, bem como a infraestrutura compartilhada com parceiros externos e laboratórios associados. Exige conhecimento técnico, organização e responsabilidade no trato com informações sensíveis.

O papel se traduz, na prática, nas seguintes tarefas (Jobs to be Done):

Responsabilidades

  • Administrar os principais ambientes de computação em nuvem (cloud computing) da empresa: gerenciar Google Cloud, AWS e similares, provisionar recursos para novos projetos, manter segurança e organização dos acessos, atuando como ponto focal técnico da infraestrutura de cloud, inclusive em colaboração com laboratórios parceiros;
  • Gerenciar contas e acessos em plataformas corporativas: controlar usuários e permissões em ferramentas como Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Notion, entre outras, garantindo governança e rastreabilidade;
  • Atuar nos fluxos de onboarding e offboarding de colaboradores(as): garantir que os acessos e recursos estejam alinhados aos marcos de entrada e saída, coordenando com os times de Pessoas e demais áreas da Kunumi;
  • Conduzir o fluxo completo de liberação de acessos a ambientes de parceiros: criar usuários no sistema de terceiros, realizar solicitações em sistemas externos, acompanhar aprovações, lidar com interlocutores e ajustar o processo conforme novas demandas surgem (ex: adoção de máquinas virtuais, etc.);
  • Apoiar operações físicas relacionadas a dispositivos e equipamentos: organizar trocas de máquinas, recebimento e envio de equipamentos, formatação, etc, garantindo rastreabilidade e histórico;
  • Colaborar na virtualização e permissionamento de infraestrutura compartilhada com laboratórios parceiros: garantindo segurança e compatibilidade técnica com os padrões da Kunumi;
  • Garantir rastreabilidade e preparação para auditorias: assegurar que os processos executados sejam documentados e auditáveis, especialmente em relação à segurança de dados, gestão de acessos e governança digital;
  • Mapear e manter atualizados os fluxos e relatórios de controle: criar e alimentar documentos internos que orientem o processo de acessos e apoiem colegas, além de organizar dados de uso, devoluções e status de ferramentas.

O que é esperado de você

  • Experiência com Google Cloud e/ou AWS em contexto de provisionamento e controle de acessos.
  • Conhecimento sobre segurança da informação aplicadas à gestão de identidades e permissões.
  • Facilidade para navegar por múltiplos sistemas e fluxos simultâneos (ex: onboarding, solicitações, controle de acessos).
  • Experiência lidando com dados sensíveis, acessos privilegiados e responsabilidades críticas.
  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação com áreas diversas.

O que pode ser considerado um diferencial

  • Vivência com processos de acesso em ambientes regulados (saúde, finanças, etc).

  • Conforto para atuar em ambientes com baixa estrutura formal, exigindo proatividade, autonomia, senso crítico e autoconhecimento.

Na Kunumi, a curiosidade é nossa força motriz na busca incansável por conhecimento e pela coragem de desafiar o convencional. Acreditamos que a diversidade de pensamentos e perspectivas é fundamental para criar soluções únicas e impactantes.

Nossa cultura é pautada pela valorização das pessoas, do cuidado com o legado que deixamos e pela constante busca por resultados elegantes em meio a desafios complexos. Aqui, cada voz é ouvida, cada ideia é valorizada e cada conquista é celebrada em conjunto.

Somos agentes de mudança que almejam promover uma transformação positiva na sociedade por meio da Inteligência Artificial. Acreditamos no potencial humano e na capacidade de atuar como catalisadores para um futuro mais equilibrado.

  • Cultura dinâmica, diversa e focada no crescimento conjunto;

  • Recesso remunerado de final de ano

Depois de enviar sua inscrição, você receberá um email de confirmação. Acreditamos que a diversidade promove a criatividade e acelera resultados positivos, portanto, consideramos todos os candidatos não somente pela qualificação técnica, mas também como nos complementa como grupo.

Overview

Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.
  • First point of contact for regional CRAs for study-specific questions and issues. Escalates to PM and other functions as appropriate.
  • Support line managers by providing status updates on utilization and performance of CRAs.
  • Liaise with line manager for assigning sites to CRAs following line manager allocation of a CRA resource to the project.
  • Conduct CRA Assessment visits per departmental requirements to assess the performance of the CRA against their monitoring responsibilities.

Study Documents and Plans

  • Develop training materials and study tools for sites and CRAs, including monitoring plans.
  • Develop and implement enrolment and recruitment strategies together with clinical project team.
  • Develop presentation materials for and presents at Sponsor Kickoff meetings, Investigator meetings and Sponsor Calls (as needed), and prepares presentations for Site Qualification Visits and Site Initiation Visits.

Qualifications

  • College diploma/degree AND 7-9 years related experience +continuous training and knowledge/skills upgrading
  • OR Undergraduate university degree (Bachelors or Honors Bachelors) AND 4-6 years’ experience + substantial on-going job-related training

Other

  • Health Sciences, Life Sciences or Nursing specialty preferred, or SoCRA and/or ACRP Certification/Designation.
  • Should have a minimum of 3 years CRA experience, have strong experience with EDC systems, be proficient with MS Office, have strong written and verbal communication skills and highly effective interpersonal and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrate the following attributes: proactive, detail oriented, task-driven and highly organized.
  • Demonstrate the critical elements of GCPs and local regulations as they relate to clinical monitoring, IRB/EC and Investigator responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated ability in report writing and strong ability to critically understand clinical research documents.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Working Conditions

  • Home-based

    • Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate

  • Proven hands-on experience building and optimizing real-time, low-latency pipelines using PySpark, Azure Functions, Event Hubs, and Stream Analytics.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or ARM templates), configuration management, automated testing, and cost optimization principles.

  • Strong ability to work cross-functionally with architects, engineers, and data scientists, and to clearly document architecture and deployment configurations.
  • Committed to staying updated with emerging Azure technologies, AI/ML integrations, and data architecture best practices to drive innovation and efficiency

title: Program Director
description:
If digital transformation, next-generation technology, and growth opportunities excite you, then join our Netcracker Technology team! Our culture and collaborative work environment are the keys to our success. Here you will work with the best in class global teams, earn a competitive salary, and contribute to the largest digital transformations around the world.

What’s in it for you? At Netcracker, we are all entrepreneurs. This means we get creative when thinking of technical solutions, we explore possibilities and innovations, and get excited about new technology. We take complete ownership of our roles and aren’t micromanaged or left feeling like just another number. The results we achieve are highly visible to our leadership team and we are recognized for our work and promoted accordingly.

Overview

The Program Director has the two-fold role of securing and delivering professional services for the Netcracker customer base. The Program Director will be involved in E2E activities to ensure that service commitments are attainable and profitable.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow Netcracker’s on-site transformation programs, including the following:
  • Budget and business planning for projects and programs including forecasting, monitoring, and resource planning, while ensuring business profitability
  • Manage customer expectations and satisfaction
  • Generate additional profitable revenue by expanding the scope of services provided by Netcracker
  • Partner with Sales Team to support new solution revenue opportunities within accounts through the creation of calculations and proposals, execution of contract negotiations, and pre-sales consulting.
  • Represent Solution Delivery in presales activities, ensuring that Netcracker deployment methodologies are accurately represented to potential customers
  • Lead recurring governance meetings with client steering committee to ensure alignment on program milestones and future strategy.
  • Hold Account Teams accountable for project deliverables
  • Manage all resources to ensure that all program commitments are completed on time, within budget, and with high quality
  • Lead service delivery and customer support activities related to the Netcracker product suite
  • Establish and grow relationships with clients at all levels in the organization
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customer executives and SMEs, participating in strategic and roadmap discussions on business transformation.
  • Lead cross-functional, multi-cultural, geographically dispersed teams
  • Establish and manage MBOs/KPIs for the team
  • Partner with leadership to create and maintain departmental staffing plans, organizational charts, budgets, and other appropriate departmental documentation
  • Interact with Engineering and Product Management departments in an effective manner, providing input for ongoing product enhancements

Experience and Requirements

  • Proven ability to lead multi-million, business transformational programs in
    volving complex technical solutions, for OSS/BSS Telecoms projects.
  • Required experience with writing and reviewing contracts , SOWs, and other commercial agreements
  • Proven ability to handle program governance, ensuring alignment on program milestones and future strategy
  • Ability to build and execute resource plans (on/offshore)
  • 10 years management experience, at least 3 years at senior levels
  • Experience running multi-million programs
  • Extensive experience with project management methodologies
  • Ability to build relationships at multiple levels within the client organization
  • Experience working in a matrixed corporate environment
  • Ability to travel
  • Must be able to work from the office in a Hybrid mode
  • A fluent English speaker - is a must

Education

  • University Degree in Computer Science or related field

Who is Netcracker Technology? We are a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization, and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

We help you focus on the most important step you\'ll take. Your next one.

Take your strategy, your operations, and your business forward today.

title: Página da Vaga | Agente Prevenção de Perdas
description:
Procuramos profissionais que sejam #SoluçãoParaoCliente , #ConfiemColaboremCompartilhem e que tenham #AlegriaEnergiaeAcolhimento !

Atuamos no varejo de moda há 50 anos e estamos presentes nos estados de São Paulo, Rio grande do Sul, Goiás, DF e Minas Gerais com 100 lojas .

Temos um ambiente alegre e acolhedor e o melhor de tudo, com possibilidade de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional!

Se você busca desafios em sua área de atuação, não abre mão de ética e respeito , tem senso de dono e acredita que juntos somos mais fortes , vem para Caedu .

Na Caedu nós trabalhamos com um propósito claro: Compartilhar o que temos de melhor para vestir histórias mais felizes. Para isso, respeitamos a diversidade, trabalhamos com senso de dono e queremos proporcionar o melhor para os nossos colaboradores e cliente SEMPRE!

Quais serão suas atividades?

  • Realizar rondas diárias em todas as dependências da loja, principalmente nas áreas de riscos, como provadores, área de vendas, estoques e caixa.
  • Fiscalizar o setor de estoque quando do recebimento e envio de mercadorias e produtos, incluindo a chegada dos caminhões, recebimento, contagem e conferência de peças e equipamentos pelos operadores, controle dos coletores e notas fiscais, de modo a contribuir para a redução de perdas e riscos para a empresa.
  • Responder pelos registros nos livros de prevenção e perdas, informando data, horário e tipo de ocorrência, com relação a colaboradores e clientes, apresentando a supervisão e gerência para controles diversos e GPP.
  • Atuar de forma discreta na prevenção de roubos e furtos nas dependências internas, entradas e saídas da loja, observando atitudes suspeitas e delitos, utilizando rádio para comunicar, obter orientações e aplicar ações de acordo com as regras e procedimentos, de modo a minimizar os riscos para a empresa, informando à gerência.
  • Acompanhar o gerente e supervisores na abertura e fechamento da loja, fazendo rondas em todo o perímetro da mesma, bem como na chegada e saída do carro forte, contribuindo para a segurança do patrimônio e numerários.
  • Contribuir para a redução dos custos com consumo de água e energia, através de vistorias de hora em hora nos setores tomando ações para eliminar consumos desnecessários.
  • Acompanhar as imagens dos monitores de segurança (CFTV) nas dependências internas da empresa, verificando as ações, monitorando as ocorrências e efetuando as gravações e backups diários com o apoio da equipe de Prevenção de Perdas de modo a registrar todos os movimentos para controles, possíveis investigações e decisões corretivas pela empresa.
  • Realizar o controle e entrega de chaves dos armários e vistorias dos pertences dos colaboradores, anotando as ocorrências em formulários específicos, informando à supervisão os problemas detectados.
  • Realizar o controle de entrada e saída dos produtos nos provadores, observando e efetuando a entrega, conferência e recebimento de fichas junto aos clientes, registrando as intercorrências em formulários específicos, conforme orientações dos manuais.
  • Conferir através do coletor com o apoio dos líderes da loja, os produtos recebidos em loja com procedência de troca, bem como executar a conferência e controle dos produtos danificados, verificando se os itens estão devidamente etiquetados e com os alarmes corretamente posicionados, solicitando ao superior ou responsável ações corretivas, com os devidos registros nos livros.
  • Realizar o atendimento a clientes na área de vendas quando necessário, auxiliando e orientando sobre a localização dos produtos, promoções e oferecendo sacolas e cartões, contribuindo assim para a satisfação dos clientes e resultados da loja.
  • Atender o cliente com simpatia, agilidade e clareza nas informações, visando a satisfação dos mesmos e a oportunidade de comercialização dos produtos.
  • Cumprir a jornada de trabalho diária, conforme escala mensal e semanal sem cometer irregularidades nas marcações e seguindo a legislação e orientações do líder e supervisor.
  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Experiência na posição de fiscal/segurança, tendo atuado em áreas de prevenção, perdas e riscos, bem como atendimento ao cliente em vendas em geral.
  • Pacote office básico e conhecimentos de sistemas de monitoramento de segurança patrimonial.

description:
Descrição da vaga

PcDs são sempre bem-vindas.

Buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia. Alguém que se motive por desafios e atue com autonomia. Precisa gostar de trabalhar em equipe e possuir espírito colaborativo.

Modelo de Trabalho: Híbrido 2x em Campinas - SP

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Trabalhar em projeto internacional com o desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades para ferramentas de automação de testes baseadas em Inteligência Artificial;
  • Implementar soluções em Java para lidar com solicitações web;
  • Criação e manutenção de APIs. Otimização de desempenho; Testar e depurar

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharias ou similares;
  • Sólido conhecimento de Java ;
  • Familiaridade com gRPC;
  • Bons conhecimentos das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento back-end e frontend;
  • Desejavel: conhecimentos em JavaScript, TypeScript e React ou Svelte.
  • Ingles avançado para conversação

Informações adicionais

O Instituto de Pesquisas Eldorado valoriza um ambiente diversificado e se orgulha de ser uma organização que oferece oportunidades de forma igualitária. Todos que se candidatarem serão avaliados, independentemente de raça, deficiência, cor, religião, sexo, identidade ou expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade ou idade.

Nosso trabalho transforma o mundo, o futuro e as pessoas.

Impulsione a sua carreira em um dos maiores centros de P&D do país. Há 25 anos, desenvolvemos soluções sob medida em software e hardware para diversos segmentos em parceria com grandes players globais da área de tecnologia. Atuamos também com testes de laboratório, consultoria de inovação, capacitação, treinamento e certificação de produtos para telecomunicações.

É a sua chance de adquirir novas experiências e aplicar seu conhecimento em projetos relevantes que impactam positivamente a vida das pessoas.

  • Somos mais de 1.600 profissionais e reconhecidos como um dos Lugares Incríveis para se Trabalhar pelo prêmio FIA/UOL.
  • Estamos em grandes polos tecnológicos do país, com unidades em Brasília, Campinas, Manaus e Porto Alegre.
  • Temos infraestrutura completa de laboratórios, especialmente o de microeletrônica, que é referência em todo o país.
  • Somos o único membro da América Latina da associação europeia EARTO.
  • Temos expertise em tecnologias como inteligência artificial, visão computacional, computação gráfica, realidade virtual e aumentada, assistentes virtuais e interface por voz, big data e analytics, openRAN, sistemas embarcados, IoT e blockchain.

title: Principal Architect São Paulo, Brazil, Remote
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Your Career

As a Principal Architect you will serve as a trusted executive advisor responsible for influencing our clients’ cybersecurity transformation strategies and driving them to successful security outcomes. The role focuses on enhancing the productivity of field sales teams by delivering business-relevant consulting engagements to strategic prospects and customers. In this Director-level role you will lead, direct, and advise cross-functional teams to orchestrate strategic, advisory-style client engagements that keep sales campaigns aligned with customer executive priorities.

Your primary goal is to influence and empower customers to embrace the Palo Alto Networks platform by delivering authoritative architectural roadmaps that create a bridge between the full breadth of Palo Alto Networks’ security solutions and solutions that address the client's business needs.

The Principal Architect is expected to be familiar with and conversant in all major security domains, including Secure Access Service Edge/Zero Trust (SASE/ZT), Cloud Security, Security Operations, and Identity Security. Ideal candidates will have deep technical knowledge of and hands-on experience in one or more of those domains.

Your Impact

Strategic Advisory and Client Engagement:

  • Establish and maintain executive-level relationships (Manager, Director, VP, and CxO contacts) in strategic accounts with high growth potential.

  • Transform client security strategies by driving conversations that advocate for Palo Alto Networks’ view of transformative Solution Architectures.

  • Provide valuable insights and education to clients on effective risk reduction, operational excellence, and cost management.

  • Identify and document the client's strategic transformation goals and priority outcomes for value realization, collaborating with specialists to develop business cases around measurable benefits.

  • Conduct high-impact consulting engagements, including architectural assessments, designs, and client workshops, setting and driving a strategic agenda with the customer and sales/engineering teams.

Sales Productivity and Thought Leadership:

  • Demonstrate increased sales productivity through strategic architectural engagements.

  • Engage directly with senior technical and business leaders as a security expert to expand reach within accounts and expand the scope of sales opportunities by identifying new areas of engagement and areas where our solutions can deliver on executive priorities.

  • Collaborate with sales teams to develop and deliver differentiated proposals that clearly demonstrate business and technical value.

Internal Partnership and Development:

  • Become a valued resource to Product Management by discovering and understanding current challenges, competitive insights, and opportunities to address emerging needs in strategic market segments.

  • Provide summarized and business-relevant feedback to content, Product Management, Product Marketing, Competitive Marketing, and Field Marketing to improve the effectiveness of the value proposition.

  • Maintain continuous self-improvement and learning to sustain technical leadership across relevant technologies (e.g., security technologies, cyber threat intelligence, risk and regulatory topics, emerging technologies)

  • Work closely with Sales and Solution Consulting leadership, Unit42 consulting teams, Business Value Consultants, Professional Services, Customer Success, and theater CISO/CTO resources (where applicable) to ensure a coordinated market approach.

Your Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience as an end customer, a cybersecurity vendor or consultant is required.

  • Education: BSCS, equivalent degree or experience is required.

  • Architectural Knowledge:

    • Extensive knowledge of core security architectures, history, and trends spanning network, endpoint, and hybrid environments.

    • Solid fundamental background in principles and practices of networking and/or cloud computing.

    • Knowledge of security areas such as network security, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud security, identity management, security operations, SIEM, endpoint security, and emerging topics related to cybersecurity and AI.

  • Executive Presence: Demonstrable experience in establishing credibility and strategic messaging with large enterprise executives (CISO and above).

  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills, both internally and externally.

  • Drive and Problem Solving:

    • A \"Whatever it takes\" attitude and motivation to overcome obstacles necessary to achieve desired outcomes and close deals.

    • Robust problem finding and solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex problems with systematic approaches to quick resolution, even under duress.

  • Travel: Expect to travel a minimum of 50%+ of the weeks in the fiscal year. Travel will include customer and company location onsite meetings.

  • Organizational Skills: Superb organizational skills are required.

Our Commitment

We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

  • Gestão de Funil: manter o CRM e o processo de cadência de contatos organizados para garantir a previsibilidade das vendas.

  • Experiência em Vendas Internas (Inside Sales): histórico comprovado em pré-vendas, geração e qualificação de leads B2B.

  • Foco em Desenvolvimento de Negócios: movido por metas, capaz de identificar e nutrir oportunidades de crescimento.

Local de Trabalho e Remuneração

Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina.   • Liderar e gerenciar equipes de tecnologia, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.

  • Sólida compreensão técnica em engenharia backend.
  • Excelente habilidade de comunicação e capacidade de trabalhar efetivamente com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e práticas de DevOps.
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas.
  • Capacidade de desenhar soluções técnicas eficazes, alinhando tecnologia e estratégia do negócio

Para Realçar o Sabor:

  • Conhecimento em outras áreas de desenvolvimento de software e tecnologias emergentes.

title: Líder de Unidade | Campinas - Shopping Campinas
description:
Job description

Sua missão como Líder de Unidade

Possuir habilidades em vendas e atendimento ao cliente.

Liderar as atividades comerciais em nível corporativo, desenvolvendo estratégias de vendas, assegurando o cumprimento de metas e demonstrando comprometimento com o desempenho da equipe e os resultados.

Prospectar e captar clientes e parcerias , tanto de forma presencial quanto online, identificando oportunidades de mercado e negócios.

Ser responsável por liderar a clínica em suas operações diárias , garantindo a excelência no atendimento.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades do cargo

  • Gerir as metas, tanto mensais quanto por dezenas, bem como realizar os planos de ação para o alcance das mesmas;
  • Acompanhar os indicadores;
  • Atender clientes para esclarecer dúvidas e tratar demais assuntos relacionados ao serviço e ao tratamento prestados pela empresa;
  • Prezar pelo padrão da unidade nos critérios de limpeza, organização e cumprimento de todos os protocolos adequados à fiscalização;
  • Gerir os insumos necessários para a unidade sob sua liderança;
  • Ser a porta-voz e defensora das diretrizes da empresa perante clientes internos e externos;
  • Realizar ações proativas na captação de parcerias e indicações de Leads, desenvolvendo e implementando estratégias para atingir as metas da unidade;
  • Elaborar a escala de trabalho e realizar a gestão do ponto da equipe sob sua liderança;
  • Garantir a qualidade e a eficiência no atendimento ao cliente;
  • Monitorar e analisar o desempenho da unidade, implementando melhorias quando necessário;
  • Realizar o fechamento do caixa, sendo necessário profissional com disponibilidade de horário;
  • Gerir, motivar e desenvolver a equipe, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo;
  • Solucionar problemas, mantendo a excelência no atendimento e zelando pela reputação da empresa;
  • Manter a unidade em conformidade com as normas internas e regulamentos exigidos pela legislação;
  • Executar demais atividades correlatas.

Requirements and skills

Requisitos e habilidades

  • Ensino médio completo – Graduação (em andamento ou concluída) será um diferencial;
  • Experiência comprovada em gestão de vendas e liderança de equipes;
  • Excelentes habilidades organizacionais (multitarefa e planejamento) e de comunicação;
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões de forma eficaz;
  • Orientação para resultados, com foco na qualidade do atendimento;
  • Proatividade e habilidade para trabalhar sob pressão.

Additional information

Benefícios:

  • Assistência médica (70% custeada pela empresa, com coparticipação);
  • Vale-refeição/ alimentação no valor de R$ 500,00;
  • Seguro de vida (100% custeado pela empresa);
  • Convênio com a TotalPass;
  • Vale-transporte.

title: Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD
description:
Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD

Head of Product Growth, LearnWith.AI (Remote) - $400,000/year USD role at Trilogy.

This range is provided by Trilogy. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$200.00/hr - $200.00/hr

Overview

Ready to revolutionize education through AI? We are seeking a visionary product strategist to spearhead our Education vertical and champion a mission that matters: helping students learn more effectively through personalized instruction. This isn\'t about incremental improvements—it's about fundamentally reimagining how education works.

As our Head of Product Growth, you\'ll craft the strategic blueprint that unifies our educational offerings into a cohesive ecosystem. You\'ll author our definitive "Brain Lift" strategy document and translate it into actionable roadmaps that make our products work in harmony. This player-coach role requires you to dive deep into critical work while guiding a talented team of Product Owners toward measurable impact.

We\'re challenging the status quo of one-size-fits-all education by building a system rooted in learning science and AI that adapts to each student\'s unique needs. Our mission is proving that education can be simultaneously personalized and powerful.

This position diverges from conventional product leadership roles. Success here isn\'t measured by process management or delegation skills, but by your ability to drive tangible outcomes through first-principles thinking, analytical rigor, and unwavering determination.

Working directly with founders and leading a sharp team, your ultimate metric is straightforward: demonstrable evidence that your strategy has meaningfully enhanced student learning outcomes. If you\'re energized by accountability and eager to tackle education\'s most significant challenges, we should connect.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Craft and Evolve the Strategic Framework: Develop and continuously refine the comprehensive "Education Domain BrainLift"—a living strategic document that synthesizes team insights, market intelligence, and learning science into a unified vision guiding the entire vertical.
  • Orchestrate Portfolio Development: Transform strategic vision into an outcome-focused roadmap that coordinates all products within our ecosystem. You\'ll determine the strategic sequencing that maximizes compounding value and provides the "why" behind every initiative.
  • Lead Through Action and Mentorship: Serve as both strategist and practitioner—running your own rapid OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) loops on mission-critical objectives while elevating your team through thoughtful review and strategic guidance to ensure cohesive execution across the portfolio.

What You Won’t Be Doing

  • Functioning solely as a people manager. While leadership is essential, your value comes from strategic direction and execution standards, not administrative oversight of headcount and budgets.
  • Implementing predetermined strategies. You won\'t be executing someone else\'s vision—you\'ll be crafting the comprehensive strategy yourself, building it from first principles and ground-level insights.
  • Maintaining rigid, unchanging roadmaps. Your portfolio strategy will evolve continuously, incorporating weekly learnings and adapting to new discoveries from your team\'s work and your own investigations.
  • Managing disconnected feature development. Success isn\'t measured by feature quantity but by strategic outcomes that create synergy across products, breaking down silos to deliver unified educational experiences.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years in product leadership positions where you personally developed product vision and owned fundamental problem-solution hypotheses
  • Proven track record launching at least one successful product from conception to market—specifically a complete product (not just features) that reached external users and generated minimum $1M in revenue
  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating AI tools into your professional workflow (analysis, research, strategy development, information synthesis)

About LearnWith.AI

LearnWith.AI is an edtech startup that leverages AI and subject matter experts to cultivate a new way of learning. Our unique approach leverages 50+ years of learning science, cutting-edge data analytics and AI-powered coaching. In doing so, we can help students learn more, learn faster, and learn better - and have fun while doing it. We are a remote-first company that hires globally via Crossover.

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $200 USD/hour, which equates to $400,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. Consult for more details on this topic.

description:
Join Our Team

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.

description:

Embora o carro tenha um papel fundamental na vida de muitas pessoas, só 25% da população da América Latina consegue ter acesso a ele. E foi por isso que a Kovi nasceu: para mudar essa estatística!

Acreditamos que todas as pessoas merecem ter a oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas e, em busca desse propósito, trabalhamos todos os dias para criar soluções de mobilidade acessíveis, flexíveis e simples.

Hoje, já oferecemos planos de aluguel no inédito modelo “pague o que usar”, compra de carros sem análise de crédito e seguro auto com contratação simplificada. E queremos continuar promovendo a inclusão, através da eficiência e inovação!

O desafio é grande, mas nossa vontade de fazer a diferença é ainda maior! E estamos buscando pessoas incríveis para fazer parte dessa revolução. Aqui, você encontrará um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e de aprendizado constante.

A Kovi está expandindo sua operação para Campinas e buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por atendimento e que queiram crescer junto com a empresa. Essa é sua chance de fazer parte de um time dinâmico e inovador, ajudando motoristas a acessarem veículos de forma simples e eficiente.

Se você gosta de desafios, quer trabalhar em um ambiente de startup e busca crescimento rápido, essa vaga é para você!

Ser Kover é sinônimo de ser super engajado quando o assunto é desafio. Amamos pessoas que se importam com outras pessoas, que tenham brilho nos olhos e vontade de sobra para mudar o mundo. Se você acredita em um mundo onde todos tenham oportunidade de dirigir suas próprias vidas, vem ser #Kover!

Atender e recepcionar clientes, fornecendo suporte e informações sobre os veículos disponíveis.

Realizar a abertura, alteração e fechamento de contratos de locação.

Realizar vistorias e checklists nos veículos antes da retirada e na devolução.

Organizar e movimentar veículos no pátio para otimizar a operação.

Conduzir veículos até postos de combustível, lojas ou serviços mecânicos quando necessário.

Oferecer serviços adicionais e upgrades, garantindo a melhor experiência ao cliente.

Trabalhar com metas e indicadores, ajudando a maximizar a performance da unidade.

Ensino médio completo.

CNH B válida e definitiva.

Experiência com atendimento ao cliente (experiência no setor automotivo ou varejo é um diferencial!).

Facilidade com tecnologia e sistemas operacionais.

Boa comunicação e proatividade para resolver problemas.

O que você vai encontrar aqui:

Seguro de Vida: Para cuidarmos do nosso bem maior: nossos Kovers.

Plano de Saúde: É importante se cuidar e estar bem.

Plano Odontológico: Para você dar aquele sorrisão bonito!

Cartão Flash: Seu VR e/ou VA em um único cartão! Até porque como diz o ditado: “saco vazio não para em pé!”

Parceria com SESC: Adesão ao benefício depois de 90 dias de contrato.

Vale-Transporte ou Vale-Combustível: A escolha de como você se move é só sua.

Pai, mãe e filhos: Auxílio creche, licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e licença paternidade estendida de 20 dias.

Wellhub: Todos os Kovers têm direito a se exercitar com parte do valor subsidiado pela Kovi.

Seja um Kover e venha transformar vidas através da mobilidade

Na Kovi, acreditamos que mobilidade muda direções. Nascemos em 2018 com um propósito claro: criar oportunidades para que todos possam dirigir suas vidas. Hoje, somos referência em oferecer soluções inovadoras para clientes, promovendo inclusão financeira e autonomia para quem movimenta as cidades.

Mais do que uma empresa de tecnologia, somos um time apaixonado por impacto real. Aqui, combinamos dados, empatia e ousadia para criar um ecossistema justo, sustentável e acessível. E isso é só o começo.

Nossa cultura é viva, diversa e colaborativa. Valorizamos pessoas curiosas, que aprendem rápido, pensam diferente e constroem junto. Na Kovi, você tem liberdade para ser quem é, e espaço para crescer como nunca imaginou.

Acreditamos no poder da inovação como motor da mudança. Por isso, incentivamos ideias novas, experimentações e decisões com base em dados. Também somos movidos por um forte senso de dono: cada pessoa aqui é protagonista da sua jornada.

Diversidade importa. Inclusão também. Por isso, estamos comprometidos em construir um ambiente seguro, respeitoso e acolhedor para todas as pessoas.

Se você busca propósito, desafios reais e quer fazer parte de um time que está reinventando o presente para construir um futuro mais justo, seu lugar pode ser aqui.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Video Safety

Remote - must be based in Brazil

At Platform Science, we’re working to connect everything that moves.

Founded in 2015, we are an open IoT platform that partners with innovative fleets, application developers, vehicle manufacturers, and equipment providers in the transportation industry to deliver revolutionary solutions to supply chain professionals across the globe.

Our employees are an engaging, diverse group of people who believe in the power of great ideas. We hire people with different experiences and perspectives to build a company culture that fuels growth through innovation. We value thoughtful actions and empathy for others. We approach challenges with resiliency and creativity, while encouraging transparency because, no matter our backgrounds or responsibilities, we are one team.

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Software Engineering Manager to lead our Video Safety engineering team. This critical role involves overseeing the development and enhancement of our innovative video safety software product, designed to improve the safety of commercial truck drivers on the road. Our system utilizes in-cab dashcams to detect and report safety-critical events such as driver fatigue, close following, and lane departure warnings. These events are then reviewed by back-office administrators via a dedicated portal.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor and coach team members, providing regular feedback and supporting their professional growth and career development.
  • Implement and maintain high engineering standards, best practices, and processes across the team to ensure the delivery of robust, scalable, and reliable software.
  • Coordinate and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, including product management, design, and other engineering teams, to align on goals and deliver integrated solutions, working with a global team spanning North America, Europe, and Latin America (Brazil).
  • Oversee the entire software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and design to implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
  • Drive technical excellence and innovation, ensuring the team leverages appropriate technologies and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure the team's adherence to project timelines and deliverables while maintaining a focus on quality and user experience.
  • Act as a technical leader, providing guidance and expertise in cloud infrastructure (AWS), backend development (Kotlin), and front-end technologies (React).
  • Champion a safety-first mindset within the engineering team, ensuring the product's features and performance directly contribute to safer driving practices.
  • Knowledge of Kotlin and Java

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field; Master's degree preferred.
  • Experience in software development in a leadership or management role.
  • Proven experience managing and leading high-performing software engineering teams.
  • Strong technical proficiency in cloud platforms, specifically AWS, including services like EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, and others relevant to scalable applications.
  • Experience with front-end technologies, particularly React.
  • Demonstrated experience with scaled, high-availability systems.
  • Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum) and best practices.
  • Exceptional leadership skills with a track record of leading with empathy, fostering a positive team environment, and effectively managing individual and team performance.
  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with video processing, computer vision, or IoT applications is a plus.
  • Advanced/Fluent english is mandatory - written and speaking

Desired Attributes

  • Strategic Thinker: Ability to understand the broader business context and translate it into technical strategies and team goals.
  • Result-Oriented: Drives for measurable results and holds the team accountable for commitments.
  • Adaptable: Thrives in a fast-paced and evolving environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience.
  • Collaborative: A natural team player who builds strong relationships and fosters a cooperative work environment.
  • Passionate about Safety: Genuinely cares about the impact of our product on commercial truck driver safety.

title: Agente de SAC - E-commerce (Vestuário) - Sazonal
description:
Agente de SAC - E-commerce (Vestuário) - Sazonal

Somos a 1° startup do Brasil a ter operações de Contact Center 100% no modelo home office.

Você é apaixonado por alcançar metas, está motivado a superar desafios e se colocar no lugar do outro enquanto faz parte de uma equipe dinâmica? Aqui é o seu lugar!!

Estamos à procura de profissionais dedicados, ambiciosos, apaixonados por alcançar metas e motivados a superar desafios para integrarem nossa equipe como Agentes de Atendimento, focados no SAC Multiskill para o e-commerce de uma marca de roupas e calçados.

Buscamos nos conectar com pessoas e aqui a gente preza pela igualdade de oportunidades e a inclusão da diversidade para todos os públicos. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Agente de solução em atendimento Multiskill via voz, ticket, e-mail e chat do e-commerce de uma rede de marcas de roupa de grife e calçados;
  • Você irá atender trocas e devoluções, estorno e reembolso;
  • Direcionar as reclamações e elogios recebidos aos setores/departamentos responsáveis;
  • Em todos os canais de comunicação é necessário ouvir atentamente o cliente buscando sempre o envolver, conduzir de forma prática o contato, possuir empatia, compreendendo a necessidade do cliente;
  • Nas mídias sociais será responsável por responder as reclamações e elogios dos clientes dos nossos anúncios.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Experiência com atendimento em SAC de vestuário/e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento básico no ramo da moda;
  • Possuir agilidade, escrita e dicção boa;
  • Experiência com atendimento em multicanais – voz, chat e e-mail;
  • Possuir habilidades em atuar no modelo home office;
  • Ter um espaço adequado para atuar home office (Mesa, cadeira e ambiente sem ruído);
  • Residir em São Paulo/ Grande São Paulo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar presencial em escritório no bairro Vila Olímpia sempre que requerido pela empresa/liderança;
  • Possuir internet cabeada com mais de 10 MB (Sem utilizar o Wifi);
  • Habilidade em manusear diversos plataformas de trabalho (Zendesk, WhatsApp, Telefone, chat e Pacote Office).

Informações adicionais

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1 – Horário a combinar de acordo com operação

Benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Auxilio Creche (Crianças de até 24 meses);
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • TotalPass;
  • Descontos em cursos, faculdade e parques de diversão.

Fornecemos Notebook, Mouse e Headset.

title: Product Manager, Lending
description:
Overview

Clutch is on a mission to transform Credit Unions into fintechs — helping them deliver digital experiences that rival the best banks and lenders in the world.

As a Product Manager on the Lending Application Intake team, you’ll support the core member application experience that powers our lending platform. You’ll work closely to deliver small features that improve the speed, accuracy, and usability of loan applications — from initial intake through decisioning.

This is a hands-on learning role where you’ll develop the fundamentals of product management within a fast-paced fintech environment. You’ll learn how digital lending works, how credit unions serve their members, and how to turn complex workflows into simple, delightful product experiences, driving impact to our credit union customers and their members.

About the Team

You’ll join a high-talent density Product & Engineering org with a culture of ownership, speed, and judgment. PMs here work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and GTM peers, driving clarity and tough tradeoffs instead of waiting for direction.

This is a pivotal time at Clutch: we are on a strong growth path, and how we scale account opening in the next 12 months will define how Clutch builds durable company leverage.

What You’ll Do

Within 3 months, you will:

  • Learn the fundamentals of Clutch’s Digital Lending experience, workflows, and customer personas.
  • Partner with a Senior PM and triad partners (Design + Engineering) to deliver small features and improvements end-to-end.
  • Collaborate with engineering to validate features and ensure quality delivery.
  • Shadow customer calls and internal standups to understand how fintech products serve real-world credit union needs.

Within 6 months, you will:

  • Contribute to backlog refinement, writing crisp product specs, and maintaining feature documentation.
  • Own a well-defined part of our product and lead quarterly planning for it with guidance from your manager.
  • Analyze user feedback and product data to inform backlog prioritization.
  • Present updates in demos and share learnings with your peers.

Within 9 months, you will:

  • Independently manage a small product area or recurring improvement track
  • Develop the ability to independently identify, scope, and propose enhancements that drive measurable customer impact.
  • Turning urgent needs into repeatable, scalable systems
  • Demonstrate growth in product judgment, cross-functional collaboration, and ownership mindset.

What You’ll Bring

  • Execution excellence : Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments; you bring urgency, energy, and follow-through. A strong signal is 2+ years of PM experience in B2B or fintech environments.
  • Collaboration skills : You partner across product, engineering, and GTM — holding the line on judgment while ensuring customers feel heard.
  • Growth mindset: A growth mindset and willingness to receive and act on feedback to improve quickly.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility : Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.
  • Unforgettable Off-Sites : Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.
  • Paid Time Off and National Holidays : Enjoy 20 PTO days yearly and the National Holidays for relaxation and rejuvenation.
  • Stock Options : Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.
  • Home Office Setup : Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.
  • Work Trip Budget : Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Please note : This position is offered on a contractor basis. Applicants must have the necessary documentation and authorization to work in the country where the job is located. Clutch cannot provide sponsorship or assist with obtaining work permits for this role.

A Note About AI at Clutch : We love AI. We use it often and encourage our team to creatively and effectively leverage AI tools in their work. If you join Clutch, we hope you'll bring the same enthusiasm for exploring how AI can amplify impact, productivity, and innovation. That said, during the interview process, we want to hear your thoughts. Please approach interviews without the use of AI tools—our goal is to get to know how you think, solve problems, and communicate. Once you're in the seat, bring on the prompts!

title: Finance Development Program
description:
Join Our Finance Development Program - FP&A entry level role and embark on a journey to enrich your financial expertise through hands-on training and on-the-job experiences. Join to apply for the Information Technology Manager role at LEDN

4 weeks ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Ledn's core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

What You Will Do

  • You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks.
  • You will be customer-facing and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc.
  • Manage Mac endpoints and mobile device management tools (e.g., MDM, Jamf).
  • Procure and deliver technology equipment; own the onboarding experience for all new employees and retrieval for outgoing employees.
  • Design, test, build, and document programs, policies and tools; contribute improvements to existing knowledge.
  • Support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace, Slack, Jamf Pro/Protect/Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.
  • Own improvements on identity and access management, including IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta).
  • Develop automation scripts and build infrastructure as code; integrate systems via APIs; write helpful articles and automate busywork.
  • Manage, respond to, and resolve critical incidents and issues through completion; prioritize help desk tickets and work on projects over sprints (agile).
  • Set and pursue objectives and key results aligned with team and company goals; report progress with minimal direction.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, Python, etc.
  • Experience with open-source tooling such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta and create workflows in Okta; experience with API integrations.
  • Remote support experience across multiple countries/time zones; capable of hardware shipping/receiving and customs.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication across media; clear, friendly, concise communication respectful of diverse cultures.
  • A security-aware mindset; understanding of PGP and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching).
  • Methodical troubleshooting across OSI layers and ability to scope projects and manage multiple priorities.
  • Self-management with strong organizational and task-management skills; comfortable handling ambiguity.

Nice To Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS.
  • Experience with GAM and command-line efficiency improvements.
  • Jamf, Okta, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

  • We look for leaders who thrive in startup/tech environments, with adaptability, resilience, and a builder's mindset to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
  • Ability to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity; integrity and accountability in handling confidential information.
  • Experience in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • Growth opportunities at a leading digital asset company.
  • Comprehensive total rewards package from day one.
  • Competitive PTO; ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote-friendly policy allowing work from anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career with barriers removed so you love what you do.

Ledn is an equal opportunity employer and values inclusivity and diversity. For accommodation requests throughout the recruitment process, contact the Ledn team by email. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters, please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.
